headline: Review of trust fund balances, the Huntress Fund, and the Powers and Clough Funds.
summary: The meeting covers current fund balances, status updates on several trust funds including Huntress, Powers, Clough, and Fernald, and discussion of ideas for using accumulated Huntress Fund income. The board will also discuss an overall strategy for remaining funds and set dates for future meetings.
items: Opening remarks from Commissioner Karen Bell
Review of current balances from Funds and explanation of Huntress Fund size and location, presented by Linda Pata
Status of 5 funds with disbursements authorized in January 2026 or earlier and the ornamental tree fund transferred to DPW
Update on status of Powers and Clough Funds with reference to probate court decrees, including Margaret Irving Powers Memorial Fund and Clough Vocational School Fund
Report from Rocco DeFilippis about his research on Action and the Housing Authority related to the Fernald Fund with MA AG Office
Ideas for disbursements from accumulated income of Huntress Funds
location: 9 Dale Avenue, First Floor Conference Room, Gloucester, Ma 01930
